question: What is the correct control to isolate a training-time supervision effect from an inference-time context effect?
description: The planned comparison is triple-only training vs context-enriched training. But the field's strongest results come from inference-time context; the fair and decisive comparison is context-enriched training evaluated with the same inference-time context as a triple-only model, plus a training-free context baseline at matched budget. Comparing models that receive different context at test time conflates the training effect with the inference-context effect.
rationale: Given that inference-time context methods dominate the landscape and a training-free system is competitive with trained systems (C006), a supervision effect can only be claimed if the inference-time context is held constant or included as a factor.
